name: 21136 · Reisterstown, MD
findings: ZIP 21136 (Reisterstown) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21136 (Reisterstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
